clock.reset: 00:00 city time, Singapore and Kuala Lumpur, all three games. If server load ever bites, the hour moves for all three together.

day.t: Reset. The app asks for today’s gem. BaD deals five dishes and one Pantry per city; HMD rolls Today’s Service and the Champion order; OXP rolls the Daily Gauntlet map. The first Prep window opens.
Second Prep window. Missed windows queue: a cook who opens the app at 20:00 picks four in a row.
Fourth Prep window. From here every HMD cook carries all four permanent augments; the evening is when the horde falls.
Leftovers hour. More on the table in every room until midnight.
Play. A plate takes three minutes, an HMD fight exactly three, an OXP run about fifteen. Bots fill empty seats with a random class and the day’s average loadout.

leftovers.t: The portion cap lifts on shelves that are still plentiful (built).
The Special offer before the bell is four wide instead of three.
Every relic offer gains a fourth option, a Leftover relic that melts after a few fights.

habits.t: Built. Chilli portions at two or more.
Built. Any item at five portions, or twice the recipe count.
The class palate fired on a non-cursed plate.
Placed adjacent to an Emerald cut.
Rang the bell during Leftovers hour.
Fought with the same four friends as the last time.
Spent a Limit Token on turn one.

perks.t: When the city passes its plate mark, Leftovers hour opens at 20:00 for everyone in the city.
perks.mark: Launch guess 1,500 plates Singapore · 1,200 Kuala Lumpur; reset to the trailing-week median every Monday.

perks.t: When the city passes its kill mark, the next Prep window’s offer is four wide for everyone in the city.
perks.mark: Launch guess 60,000 kills Singapore · 50,000 Kuala Lumpur; same weekly reset.

gifts.t: Plated today: the Special offer before the bell is four wide.
gifts.why: Widens a choice; adds no stat.

gifts.t: Plated today: the run’s first relic offer is four wide.
gifts.why: Widens a choice; adds no stat.

gifts.t: Fought today: one more dish swap.
gifts.why: More room to express; the judge is untouched.

gifts.t: A party that plays both combat games together on one day earns the Same table chip.

bin.register: Warm, still short. The Bin likes you and will not say so directly.
rules: Sentence case, full stops, no exclamation marks, no emoji. Fourteen words or fewer a line.
About the plate, the fight or the run; never about the player’s rank or skill.
One line per moment. The Bin never praises a cursed plate or an empty table.
Numbers are written as the player would say them: 612, not six hundred and twelve.
About thirty lines per game per moment type; seeded from the result so the same result gets the same line.

lines.l: Sticky floor tonight and the knives are sharp. Bring a Warden.
All 999 before the bell. The floor is a disgrace and I would not change it.
612 before the fall. The rest were finished for you. I counted every one.
206. The horde barely noticed. Come back after the six o’clock pick.
Three roads. The middle one is hot and pays for it.
Ten courses. The Colossus is toffee now. Sit down, you have earned the chair.
Row nine. The Colossus called you bland. It is wrong, but it is big.
The Critic came and you did not embarrass me. That is the whole review.
The Bin’s line is the headline of every card, in all three rooms.

shareCard: BaD’s 326px card for all three games: logo and pixel label, city and date, the dish or fight or run, the Bin’s line, the result in your gem (three stones; kills before the end; rows cleared), avatar and class, the two-line tagline.

dataFiles.t: Budget rule, gem modifiers, Heat base, the three gems with their OXP kits, nine classes with derived stats, kits and cuts.
Fight constants, Courses and units with mix shares, horde budget, Champions by slot, conditions with triggers and exclusions, augment pool counts, tuning targets.
Seat rules, map generation, augment layers, TTK targets, the pool of twenty plus the Critic, abilities, modifiers, relics, scoring, tuning targets.
As built, the judge, the class and gem ruling, nine palates.
The clock, Leftovers hour, habits, City Table, gifts, the Bin, the share card, this list.
